description: Monitor companies, scan the market feed, or look up people. All sources are public and cookieless.

companies.description: Company names, domains, tickers, SEC CIKs or UK company numbers. Examples: `apple.com`, `Monzo Bank Limited`, `AAPL`, `0000320193`, `09446231`.
companies.title: Companies (companyMonitor)

country.description: Filter moves by company country. SEC sources are US; Companies House is GB; press and leadership pages use the site's country when it can be inferred.
country.title: Country

dateFrom.description: Start date (inclusive) in YYYY-MM-DD format. Leave empty to use the lookback window.
dateFrom.title: Date from

dateTo.description: End date (inclusive) in YYYY-MM-DD format. Leave empty for today.
dateTo.title: Date to

includeCompanyProfile.description: Fetch company metadata (ticker, SIC industry, address) from SEC submissions. Adds one request per unique company.
includeCompanyProfile.title: Include company profile fields

includeInitialLeadershipTeam.description: When a leadership page is seen for the first time, emit its current team as appointments. Off by default so the first run only stores the baseline.
includeInitialLeadershipTeam.title: Emit first leadership snapshot

industry.description: Filter by broad industry sector derived from the company's SEC SIC code.
industry.title: Industry

leadershipPages.description: Optional leadership/team page URLs for companyMonitor. Leave empty to auto-discover common paths on each company domain.
leadershipPages.title: Leadership page URLs

lookbackDays.description: Used when Date from is empty: how many days back to scan.
lookbackDays.title: Lookback days

maxItems.description: Stop after this many de-duplicated moves.
maxItems.title: Max moves

mode.description: Monitor companies: moves for the companies you list. Market feed: all moves in a date range. People: reported moves for specific names.
mode.title: Mode

moveType.description: Filter by the type of leadership move.
moveType.title: Move type

newsroomUrls.description: Optional company newsroom, press-release or RSS URLs. Leave empty to search Google News by company name.
newsroomUrls.title: Newsroom / press release URLs

people.description: Person names to look up in SEC filings, Companies House officer records and press releases.
people.title: People (people mode)

roleLevel.description: Filter by seniority inferred from the new or previous title.
roleLevel.title: Role level

sources.description: Which public sources to query. SEC sources work in all modes; Companies House and leadership pages work in companyMonitor (Companies House also in people mode); press releases work in all modes.
sources.title: Sources

title: Executive Moves Tracker Input
